item.title: Eri
item.description:
Fourteen at the story’s start. A defiant punk – outwardly confident, practical, observant, dry. Secretly the princess of Kraeta.

She refuses to stay blind.

Beyond

Daughter of King Lachesis and Queen Hren. Her father set an anchor on her forehead at age four; it is what unlocks the blink.

item.title: The Anchor
item.description:
A mark set on Eri’s forehead by her father when she was four.

Beyond

It is what unlocks the blink.

item.title: The Still Point
item.description:
Control through release. To blink cleanly, let the feeling go.

Beyond

It is the tragic loop: releasing emotion to blink is exactly what hollows her. She saves the world and loses the ability to feel it.

item.title: The Thread Dimension
item.description: A tapestry of every life. Each thread is a person, and a thread can be followed to where that person once stood.
